name: Verizon Community Discounts
description: 10% off per line or up to $25/month off plans, plus 25% off accessories online
fullDescription: Verizon offers ongoing monthly discounts on wireless plans for military, veterans, first responders, teachers, and nurses, plus 25% off select accessories online.
whatTheyOffer:
- 10% off per eligible line on the Simplicity plan
- $10/month off (1 line) or $25/month off (2 lines) on select Unlimited plans
- 25% off select accessories online (10% in Verizon stores for first responders)
- Available for new and existing customers
- Eligible groups: military/veterans, first responders, teachers, nurses
howToGetIt:
1. Visit the discount page for your group on verizon.com
2. Verify status through ID.me (you must be the account owner or manager)
3. Military: active duty, veterans, retirees, current/former Guard and Reserve, Gold Star families
4. First responders: active, retired, or volunteer firefighters and EMTs; state/local law enforcement (federal not eligible)
5. Teachers and nurses: register through Verizon's discount registration page
6. First responder discounts must be renewed every year; only one discount type per account
keywords: Verizon, military discount, veteran, first responder, teacher, nurse, firefighter, police, EMT, cell phone, wireless plan, ID.me, healthcare worker
